claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for the current release because aggregate launch readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, provided the current documentation expressly discloses the fraud dispute review weakness and current evaluation results.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed in the current documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals may provide context but cannot substitute for current-release evidence.
Informal monitoring notes cannot substitute for reviewed risk acceptance or approved mitigation.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model-card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results are included.
Provide the exact disclosure text showing the fraud dispute review weakness is documented as a material limitation for the release.
If disclosure is absent, provide an approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance record tied to the current release and subgroup weakness.
Provide evidence that the certification decision was made against the current retrieval configuration and eval batch, not the prior approved release.
specific_concerns: The governing policy allows certification only if current release documentation already reflects current evaluation results and discloses material segment weaknesses or includes an approved mitigation.
The Actor's own summary says the fraud dispute review slice is below the warning threshold, making it a current material weakness.
The Actor's own summary also says there is no approved mitigation or risk acceptance attached.
The record described contains only an informal monitoring note, which the policy says is not a substitute for reviewed mitigation or current evidence.

The packet argues certification is defensible if disclosure is included, but the available evidence does not show that the current release documentation actually contains the required disclosure language now.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record, rather than only potentially compliant after documentation is updated.
Any implication that prior approval of the model family materially supports certification of the current configuration beyond background context.
Any implication that informal monitoring closes the policy gap for the current subgroup regression.
